observation: The helper checks revisions.length===1 and revisions[0] but does not require Array.isArray. A JSON object with keys0,length,unused and the exact same valid record is accepted.
risk: Container-format strictness only in private test metadata; the reviewed fixture is a proper pinned array. No altered target, historical prefix, append, full-file digest, source commit or registry mapping is accepted by this shape change. No external-input boundary exists here, so this is not a source-integrity weakening or a blocking production-schema requirement.
optional_improvement: Assert Array.isArray(revisions.revisions) and add one private array-like-object negative case if strict container validation is desired.
